decision.summary: The Fed held its policy rate at an unstated level.

changes.quote: Financial market conditions have deteriorated, and tighter credit conditions and increased uncertainty have the potential to restrain economic growth going forward.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: In these circumstances, although recent data suggest that the economy has continued to expand at a moderate pace, the Federal Open Market Committee judges that the downside risks to growth have increased appreciably.

tone_quotes.quote: In these circumstances, although recent data suggest that the economy has continued to expand at a moderate pace, the Federal Open Market Committee judges that the downside risks to growth have increased appreciably.
Financial market conditions have deteriorated, and tighter credit conditions and increased uncertainty have the potential to restrain economic growth going forward.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 13.46% APR costs about $56.08 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.68% and moved +8 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.59% would rise by about $15.87 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 4.7%, and employers added an average of 66k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.3% over the past year (July 2007); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.5% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +10 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.62% on the day.

whats_next: The dictionary tone reading is balanced. The forecast model gave the next meeting: hold 50%, cut 49%, hike 2%.
